page.layout: One block of running text in one column; page number top right; signature B 5 at the foot centre-left and catchword "fide," at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: fratribus provincia vestra, respondi publicè de politia Mosis observatione, & Illustribus Batavia Ordinibus Dominis amplissimis inscripsi, ut meum illud responsum vestris hominibus datum & Hollandia pariter communicaretur auctoritate patrocinioque ipsorum: in eundem modum quod auctoribus nonnullis qui in Hollandia regno Christi serviunt, de hac quaestione potui conscribere, id nunc V. A. ratus sum dicari oportere, ut patrocinio & auctoritate vestra Ecclesiis etiam Christi quae istic sunt, bono publico dideretur. Atque hac quidem ratio (nisi me animus fallit) tum ad aedificationem omnium maximè quae est in fide,

page.notes: Scan is a faded early modern page; the words are transcribed as legible. Some letters in the top lines are uncertain ("quae" for "quæ", "dideretur"), and the marginal decorative ink marks are not text. The "&" ligatures are rendered as printed (& for the Et sign, the "ꝰ"-style sign after "vestra" is rendered as "&"). Possible uncertainty: "fide," at the foot may be a catchword rather than running text, and is given as catchword and also ends the text on a half-line, which is a transcription choice.
